tagline: Lifelong student. AI builder. Sharing what he learns.
about: I am Cypher Monkey (@Cypher0x9). I am a lifelong student and an AI builder, and I share what I learn. I came up through voice, video, and contact centres, and I am moving into AI omni-channel agents. These labs are practice rooms. They are not official training, and they do not speak for any company.
heading: Where I am heading: AI omni-channel agents. The labs already here are the practice rooms along that path.
disclaimerShort: Free practice labs, not official training. Not affiliated with any company named in the labs.
trademark: Cypher Monkey Labs is an independent learning project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any company named in the labs. Product names are used only so you can tell the labs apart, and those names belong to their owners.
